invariants.name: public-projection-noninterference

invariants.name: unordered-input-permutation-invariance
invariants.expected: canonical semantic output is unchanged by source-record ordering

invariants.name: restricted-linked-metadata-noninterference
invariants.expected: changes to hidden linked record IDs, summaries and digests do not change the public semantic projection

invariants.name: field-disposition-ledger-completeness

negativeControls.mutation: Move record-counter-001 from contradicts to supports.
negativeControls.reason: A contradicting source must not satisfy positive support.

negativeControls.mutation: Duplicate record-support-001 in contradicts.
negativeControls.reason: Association sets must be disjoint per feature.

negativeControls.mutation: Delete record-context-001 from the record dependency package.
negativeControls.reason: All associations must resolve to a dependency.

negativeControls.mutation: Change the counter record relation to supports but keep its association in contradicts.
negativeControls.reason: Declared record relation must match the association class.

negativeControls.mutation: Change counter record contentRetrieval from prohibited to allowed without an independent rights decision.
negativeControls.reason: A transform cannot upgrade rights.

negativeControls.mutation: Embed the pending counter-source body in the public feature response.
negativeControls.reason: A public metadata reference does not authorize content disclosure.

negativeControls.mutation: Remove the rights-pending record ID from the public-reference fixture but leave its count in an aggregate field.
negativeControls.reason: No side-channel disclosure of restricted or omitted records.

negativeControls.mutation: Replace unknown decisionTime with the export timestamp.
negativeControls.reason: Unknown time cannot be fabricated.

negativeControls.mutation: Drop observationTime or recordedTime while preserving JSON-FG time.
negativeControls.reason: JSON-FG time does not encode every temporal role.

negativeControls.mutation: Swap longitude and latitude without a declared CRS transform.
negativeControls.reason: Axis-order drift is a semantic geometry error.

negativeControls.mutation: Remove uncertainty units or method.
negativeControls.reason: Uncertainty values without dimensional/method context are incomplete.

negativeControls.mutation: Change geometryOrigin from survey_derived to measured.
negativeControls.reason: Derived geometry must not be relabelled as a direct observation.

negativeControls.mutation: Collapse the two retained hypotheses into one without a decision record.
negativeControls.reason: Alternative interpretations remain explicit until adjudicated.

negativeControls.mutation: Alter a provenance input digest or the configuration digest.
negativeControls.reason: Reconstruction lineage must be content-bound.

negativeControls.mutation: Strip properties.solAtlas while returning a valid GeoJSON Feature.
negativeControls.reason: Syntactic GeoJSON validity cannot mask loss of required profile semantics.

negativeControls.mutation: Add a restricted-only evidence record to the input and compare the canonical public projection.
negativeControls.reason: Private-only changes must not affect public observable output.

negativeControls.mutation: Permute the evidence record array and re-run canonicalization.
negativeControls.reason: Unordered set semantics must not depend on transport ordering.

negativeControls.mutation: Change only the identifier, summary and digest of a linked record whose recordVisibility and metadataVisibility are prohibited; update private references consistently.
negativeControls.reason: Restricted linked metadata must not leak through association references or provenance digest lists.

negativeControls.mutation: Mark the field-disposition ledger completed while entries remain not_assessed or source/target artifact digests are absent.
negativeControls.reason: An unexecuted or incompletely accounted-for adapter route must never be reported as qualified.

negativeControls.mutation: Embed syntheticPayload when contentRetrieval or publicDisclosure is pending or unknown (rather than explicitly allowed).
negativeControls.reason: The profile is fail-closed: both content retrieval and public disclosure must be explicitly allowed before content is embedded.

negativeControls.mutation: Remove a required field from the field-disposition ledger or duplicate another field path.
negativeControls.reason: The adapter ledger must account for the frozen source-profile field inventory exactly once.

negativeControls.mutation: Mark a linked source record's recordVisibility or metadataVisibility as prohibited while leaving a derived semantic claim or hypothesis public.
negativeControls.reason: Restrictions propagate transitively to derived semantic values; public claims cannot launder restricted source content.

negativeControls.mutation: Remove a field dependency or reference a record not present in the evidence package.
negativeControls.reason: Unknown lineage cannot be treated as public; field-level provenance is fail-closed.

qualificationRules.profileQualification: 100% of registered invariants preserved on each claimed adapter path.
qualificationRules.negativeControlQualification: 100% of registered negative controls rejected or quarantined with a reason code.
qualificationRules.privacyAndRights: Zero rights escalations and zero restricted-source disclosures.
qualificationRules.replayQualification: Canonical semantic projection digest identical across three repeated runs.
qualificationRules.ogcQualification: Run the official OGC API - Features ETS for advertised API classes separately; these profile fixtures alone do not confer OGC conformance.
qualificationRules.adapterRouteQualification: A route may be reported completed only when every registered source field has a terminal disposition, source and target artifact digests are present, and the adapter/environment versions are recorded.

validationBoundary.jsonSchemaValidates: Per-object shape, required fields, primitive types and enumerations. Field-disposition ledger states and conditional completion requirements. Evidence payload embedding only when both contentRetrieval and publicDisclosure are explicitly allowed; pending/unknown rights do not qualify. Semantic CI check compares the ledger's unique field paths with the frozen nine-field source-profile inventory and rejects missing or duplicate paths.
semanticValidatorRequired: CRS transform correctness and canonical geometry comparison
adapter field-disposition coverage against a frozen source-profile field inventory
field-level dependency closure and rights-taint propagation for derived claim, geometry, temporal, uncertainty, geometry-origin and hypothesis fields
